verdict.rationale: USCIS publishes a sanctioned representation rail. Form G-28 establishes an attorney or accredited representative's eligibility to act for a client. Representatives get dedicated online accounts to file forms and submit later G-28s on the client's behalf. The Case Status API is also explicitly offered to customers' representatives. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and a delegated machine rail for filing (no filing API; delegation is limited to attorneys and accredited reps acting through myUSCIS).
